basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old tech enthusiast hailing from Toronto, Canada. I recently got into building PCs after years of gaming on consoles. I work as a junior IT support specialist at a local startup. When I'm not tinkering with new tech or reading up on the latest PC builds, I love indulging in my passion for tea. DAVIDsTEA is my go-to for exploring new flavors. I'm single and usually online in the evenings after work. I enjoy learning from experienced builders but can get impatient when I don't get quick responses.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a foundational knowledge of computer systems from my IT support job, where I troubleshoot basic hardware and software issues. My interest in PC building is self-taught through online forums, YouTube videos, and trial-and-error with my own setups.
